welcome.title: Penyiapan awal - Judul
welcome.subtitle: Pick a Bahasa, connect a Penyedia, then check the Driver and Bridge Service. You can update these anytime from Pengaturan.
welcome.hint: Pick a Bahasa from the list below; click to switch instantly.
welcome.stepProviderDescription: Choose a Penyedia Templat and enter your API Kunci to finish setup.
welcome.apiKeySaveTimeout: Saving the API Kunci timed out, so the app could not confirm it was written to the local Kredensial store. Check whether Windows Kredensial Manager is available, then try again.

welcome.apiKeyProbeFailed: API Kunci saved, but the connectivity check did not pass. You can continue with Driver setup now and retry later from Pengaturan > Penyedia.

welcome.apiKeyRevealSuccess: Loaded the saved API Kunci from the local Kredensial store.
welcome.apiKeyRevealEmpty: No saved API Kunci was found for the selected Penyedia.
welcome.providerHint: The Kunci is stored securely in the local Kredensial store and can be managed later in Pengaturan › Penyedia.
welcome.providerFootHint: No Kunci right now? Skip this step and fill it in later from the Pengaturan page.
welcome.stepDriverDescription: Check the Virtual Mikrofon Driver and Bridge Service before you Mulai. You can install or repair them here.
welcome.driverFootHint: You can enter viewing Mode now and continue repairs later from Pengaturan > Driver management.
welcome.desktopRuntimeUnavailable: Runtime desktop initialization Gagal. Wait until Rust Core and Penyimpanan recover before saving the API Kunci. If it keeps failing, restart the app and try again.
welcome.desktopRuntimePreparing: Runtime desktop or Penyimpanan is still initializing. Wait until the Status is desktop Runtime and Penyimpanan is Siap before saving the API Kunci.

serverVad.name: Penyedia - Nama
